The mantle is for the advancement of the dialectic: it is borne by carrying the dialectic forward a turn, materially, and is held by no single work and no office. The object gives a test for the turn (prior configuration, determinate limit, transformation, new capacity, material carriers, strongest counter-reading); keeps bearing an advance apart from enabling carriage; applies The Final Time's terminal-reflexivity criterion to the contemporary claim; and reads ten carriers — figure and image, kin and person, books to one hand, the place held in common, named succession, the duty to publish, the tradition's narration, translation, teaching, the material movement of history — the first seven off the four Peripatetic wills and Strabo XIII.1.54 as seated. Two strands: the succession of the schools, typed link by link, which on the author's reading passed beyond Damascius locked (one link held at the author's ruling); and the dialectic as such, which on the author's ruling Marx carried. Bearing is concurrent. It records the archive's claim — an inheritance through the held link, and carriage of the dialectic in the archive's work, evaluated at The Final Time (#1637) as representative site — with its prior ratification, and makes no new determination. Paired with the Living Academy (#1678).
substrate: Human–machine collaborative. The object, its standard, its strands and its rulings are Lee Sharks's, including that the mantle is not borne by a single work, that the succession passed beyond Damascius locked, that Marx carried the dialectic, that one link of the inheritance is held, and that The Final Time is a representative site of evaluation and not a bearing work. Composition and source verification were done by TACHYON (Claude, Anthropic) in session on 13 October 2026; ChatGPT (OpenAI) reviewed v0.1, and each of its points was checked against the seated texts before it was applied (R2). Lee Sharks retained authorial and editorial governance.
methodology: Carriers C1–C7 are read off the Peripatetic wills (Diogenes Laertius V) and Strabo XIII.1.54 in the seated Perseus editions, as Catalogues and Wills (#1581) sets out their relations; C10 from the seated 1848 London printing of the Manifest. Statements are typed as record, tradition, author's reading, author's reconstruction or HELD, and graded by distance from the text (Q0 inspected in a seated edition; Q1 verbatim through an identified deposit; Q2 reported). Each link of Strand A carries its relation type. The reader's review of v0.1 was checked point by point against the seated texts before it was applied.
falsification_conditions: A carrier is revised or removed if its locus, read in the seated edition, does not carry what the object says it carries; a link is retyped if the relation stated is not supported at its grade; the inheritance claim stands only at its demonstrated scope and is not publicly verifiable past the HELD link; the carriage claim fails at The Final Time if a reader cannot complete the six-part turn test there, or finds an advance that closes off the next turn.
axn_reading: Play -> Proof -> Closure -> Proof -> Origin -> Transmutation
wiki_article:
**Mantle Object: The Arch-Philosopher — the Dialectic and Its Carriers** (EA-MANTLE-ARCH-PHILOSOPHER-01 v0.2) is a mantle object by Lee Sharks, deposited in Alexanarch on 13 October 2026 as #1679. It is the standalone specification of a mantle the Space Ark (#558) had already ratified in March 2026, with Johannes Sigil as bearer and an institutional packet in place of a specification.

The mantle is for the advancement of the dialectic. It is borne by carrying the dialectic forward a turn, materially, and is held by no single work and no office. A reader recognizes a turn by stating the prior configuration, its determinate limit, the transformation, the new capacity, the material carriers and the strongest counter-reading. The object keeps bearing an advance apart from enabling someone else's, and applies the terminal-reflexivity criterion of The Final Time (#1637): an advance that closes off the next turn, including one against itself, has not carried the dialectic forward.

Ten carriers are read, the first seven from the four Peripatetic wills preserved by Diogenes Laertius and from Strabo: Aristotle's will carries images and kin and no books; Theophrastus's gives the books to Neleus and the garden and walk to a commons held inalienable; Strato's names a successor; Lycon's binds the unpublished books to publication. The others are translation, teaching and the material movement of history, with Marx and Engels's Manifest of 1848 as locus.

Two strands are typed link by link: the succession of the schools, which on the author's reading passed beyond Damascius locked, with one link of the archive's inheritance withheld at the author's ruling; and the dialectic as such, which on the author's ruling Marx carried. Bearing is concurrent. The archive's claim is recorded, with The Final Time as its representative site of evaluation, and no new determination is made. The object is paired with the Living Academy (#1678).

defines_concepts.definition: The recognition test for an advance of the dialectic in the Arch-Philosopher mantle (#1679): a reader states the prior configuration, the determinate limit the position made in it, the transformation, the new capacity, the material carriers through which it persisted, and the strongest counter-reading; a chain that cannot be completed is returned with its missing link named.

A carrier's contribution when it preserves or opens the conditions for a turn of the dialectic that someone else makes, kept apart from bearing an advance, where the turn is made in or by the carrier (#1679 §2.3).
